summary: In the hotel's stairwell, light filters down through a caged skylight at the top of the open elevator shaft as six figures glide up the dark winding stairs. Neo notices a black cat slink past them and pad down the stairs, then sees a second black cat that looks and moves identically to the first. He says, "Whoa. Deja vu," and those words stop the others dead in their tracks.

what_changes.before: Notices a black cat slink past and pad down the stairs without comment
what_changes.after: Recognizes the identical second cat as an anomaly and names it: "Deja vu"
what_changes.evidence: A moment later, Neo sees another black cat that looks and moves identically to the first one.

what_changes.before: Gliding up the dark stairs together, moving steadily
what_changes.after: Stopped dead in their tracks by Neo's recognition of a deja vu
what_changes.evidence: Those words stop the others dead in their tracks.

event_hint.one_line: On their way up the hotel to reach the operator, a deja vu halts the group as a sign that something in the Matrix has changed.
